title: Frontier AI labs say their models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis. What does that mean?
hook_text: OpenAI claims to speed up math
script:
OpenAI researchers recently presented three bold claims challenging the Exponential Time Hypothesis.
This theory suggests some problems are fundamentally too complex for fast solutions.
MIT computer scientist Ryan Williams is now evaluating these high-stakes results.
Williams is specifically checking if the models actually improved algorithmic efficiency.
These findings are currently undergoing independent peer verification to confirm their validity.
If proven true, this could redefine how we approach massive computational tasks.
Would you trust a machine to solve our hardest problems?
